titre: Les espèces reculent dans les paiements
sous_titre: Part des espèces dans l'ensemble des paiements des consommateurs américains, en %

2022.texte: Cash use remained the third most popular payment choice and accounted for 18 percent of all payments in 2022.

2023.texte: Cash remained the third-most-used payment instrument, accounting for 16% of payments in 2023, down two percentage points from 2022.

2024.texte: The number of cash payments accounted for 14% of all payments.

2025.texte: Cash accounted for an average of six payments per month (14% of total payments) and remained the third most-used payment instrument.
